summary: Comprehensive testing of new Cloudinary photo management features completed. Backend: 15/16 tests passed (1 skipped). Frontend: All photo features working correctly - PhotoManager, Import page, Hotel detail with gallery, Search page with Cloudinary images.

minor.issue: Console warning in AdminHotels: '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>' - React hydration warning in table rendering (cosmetic, doesn't affect functionality)

issues: Batch name and city override inputs are only visible after preview is shown, not in initial state - this is by design

passed_tests: GET /api/config/cloudinary - returns cloud_name, upload_preset, folder
GET /api/admin/import/batches - lists import history
GET /api/admin/import/batches/{batch_id} - returns batch detail with hotels
GET /api/hotels/{id}/photos - returns structured photo array sorted by sort_order
POST /api/hotels/{id}/photos - adds new photo object
PATCH /api/hotels/{id}/photos/{photo_id}/set-primary - sets primary and unsets others
PATCH /api/hotels/{id}/photos/reorder - reorders by photo_ids array
DELETE /api/hotels/{id}/photos/{photo_id} - blocks deletion of last photo
DELETE /api/hotels/{id}/photos/{photo_id} - deletes photo and auto-promotes primary
POST /api/rooms/{id}/photos - adds room photo
PATCH /api/rooms/{id}/photos/{photo_id}/set-primary - sets room photo primary
POST /api/admin/import/preview - parses Excel with Cloudinary columns
POST /api/admin/import/execute - creates hotels with structured photos
GET /api/hotels/{id} - returns hotel with Cloudinary photos array
GET /api/hotels - returns hotels list with Cloudinary photos for search page
Frontend: Landing page loads with Cloudinary hotel cards
Frontend: Search page shows 6 hotels with 'Wasiliana Moja kwa Moja' badges for imported hotels
Frontend: Hotel detail page shows Cloudinary hero image (web 1280px)
Frontend: Hotel detail page shows 'Picha' photo gallery with Primary badge
Frontend: Admin Dashboard shows 8 hotels, 4 bookings, TZS 50,000 revenue
Frontend: Admin Hotels page shows photo count column (camera icon with count)
Frontend: Admin Import page shows Excel upload, Import History section with 2 batches
Frontend: PhotoManager component works - shows photo grid with Primary badge, set-primary/delete buttons, upload area

seed_data.cloudinary_hotels: Le grand Victoria hotel (7a9da835-6a26-4f4c-bedf-5d2954fed4b7) - 3 photos, Bwami Dubai Hotel (93ce0ded-7aaf-4497-8bca-b90be16ba2c2) - 3 photos
seed_data.import_batches: 2 batches: 'Musoma Hotels' (2 imported), 'TEST_Pytest Import' (0 imported, 2 skipped as duplicates)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Cloudinary photo features fully working. Hotels with structured photo objects show 'Picha' gallery on detail page. Import batches history shows in /admin/import. PhotoManager component in /admin/hotels/:id/photos allows setting primary, reordering, deleting photos. Room photo APIs exist but room types in test hotels don't have photos yet.

mocked_apis.M-Pesa Payment: Payment is MOCKED - user clicks 'Nimemaliza Kulipa' to simulate payment confirmation. No real Selcom/M-Pesa integration.
mocked_apis.Cloudinary Upload: Cloudinary upload is REAL via unsigned preset (habari_stays_upload). Direct browser-to-Cloudinary upload works.

verified_cloudinary_features: Excel import parses P1/P2/P3 Cloudinary columns (Original, Thumb, Mobile, Web, HD)
Photos stored as structured objects with all 5 Cloudinary URL sizes
Hotel photos API supports CRUD: get, add, set-primary, reorder, delete
Room photos API supports same operations with max 5 photos
Delete blocks last photo, auto-promotes primary when deleted
PhotoManager UI shows photo grid with hover actions
Public site uses responsive Cloudinary URLs (thumb for cards, web for hero, mobile for gallery)
Import batch history tracks imported/skipped counts
Imported hotels show 'Wasiliana Moja kwa Moja' (Contact Directly) badge
